desc:
🚗 **Scrapyard Mechanics** 🔧

Start your journey with a small garage and just a little cash! 💰

Buy wrecked cars from scrapyards, inspect them, repair their broken parts yourself, wash them, and customize them before putting them up for auction and selling them for the best price! 🔥

🔧 Expand your garage and upgrade your tools to repair more cars faster!

🚘 Discover rare vehicles, make huge profits, and build your fortune until you become the **KING OF THE SCRAPYARD!** 🏆
